crossRefs.note: God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.
Yahweh said, “I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their cry because of…
Nevertheless he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry.
In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them. In his love and in his pity he…
God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.
God remembered Noah, all the animals, and all the livestock that were with him in the ship; and God made a wind to pass…
I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh, and the waters will no…
He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
He has given help to Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy,
to show mercy toward our fathers, to remember his holy covenant,

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Moreover I have heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage, and I have remembered my covenant.
translations.bsb: Furthermore, I have heard the groaning of the Israelites, whom the Egyptians are enslaving, and I have remembered My covenant.
translations.kjv: And I have also heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage; and I have remembered my covenant.
translations.asv: And moreover I have heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage; and I have remembered my covenant.
